extracted.name: All-In Italian Pasta Salad
extracted.description: Great recipe for All-In Italian Pasta Salad.
ingredient_lines: 1 lg crown of broccoli (no stalk) rinsed and trimmed
1 (8 oz) bag shredded Italian cheese mix (any with parmesan)
instruction_lines: Drain and rinse pasta with cold water or ice cube rinse.
Do not mix until pasta is completely cooled
Add more, less, or none of an ingredient to adjust to you and your family's tastes. I go ALL-IN!
Mix all ingredient in large mixing bowl or gumbo pot(that's what I use;)
Chill for 2 hours. Garnish with sliced pepperoni and serve!
